title: CSP Nonce & 'strict-dynamic' Trust Propagation
description: Trace how a per-request nonce trusts the entry bundle, propagates to lazy chunks, and blocks injected inline scripts.

steps.label: 1. Server Mints Per-Response Nonce
steps.description: Edge middleware generates nonce='r4nd0m' in the Content-Security-Policy header and stamps it on the root <script>.

steps.label: 2. Entry Script Loads Lazy Chunk
steps.description: The trusted entry script dynamically creates a <script src='/chunk.js'>. Because 'strict-dynamic' is set, trust propagates without a nonce on the child.

steps.label: 3. Injected Inline Script Blocked
steps.description: An attacker injects <script>steal()</script> via unescaped HTML. It lacks the per-request nonce, so the engine refuses execution and emits a violation report.
